description:
Code and data accompanying the manuscript High lattice thermal conductivity in the bulk carbon-nitride family approaching cubic boron nitride.

The archive contains the initial screening table for 270 binary carbon-nitrogen structures, 25 machine-learning interatomic-potential results with input and relaxed structures, first-principles thermal-conductivity data for 11 structures, and scripts for building the tables and polymorph groups.
